request.note: Tetris development on b2d559b: portable Intent lacks separate command edges for rotate/hold/drop, requiring sentinel pointer command IDs via device_input; add optional command bits with subtick retention and controller mappings. Shared take_cues is limited to Coin/Hit/Success while AudioBankSpec rejects named effects; allow optional authored one-shot banks under the shared lifecycle. audio render also requires an existing parent directory absent from new scaffolds; document mkdir or safely create parents. Repro and priorities: docs/feedback/2026-10-21-tetris.md; learning L-315/L-316/L-317.
